2123233804525715774.en_summary: Stop blowing up when markets draw down because you are in 50 of the same trade. Test your portfolio for free. Quoted content describes a free correlation matrix tool to check if 2 assets are the same bet, up to 20 tickers. Example shows 7 open positions that move the same and lose 3.4 times more than $SPY on down days. Mentions $ASTS $ASTI $SIDU as literally the same trade. Advice to stick to no more than 3 trades per sector and 2 per industry.
2123233804525715774.zh_summary: 當市場回撤時不要因為持有 50 個相同交易而爆倉。免費測試你的投資組合。引用內容描述免費相關性矩陣工具，可檢查 2 個資產是否為相同押注，最多 20 個代號。示例顯示 7 個開倉在下跌日損失為 $SPY 的 3.4 倍。提及 $ASTS $ASTI $SIDU 實際上是相同交易。建議每個板塊不超過 3 筆交易，每個行業不超過 2 筆。
